# Glossary

Living terminology discovered from the code. Function names, class names, config keys, CLI flags, domain concepts, deprecated names, and the canonical spelling of each.

The ingest hook adds a row here whenever a new term appears in a diff. It also flags conflicts (same concept, two names) in the log.

| Term                              | Definition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | First seen in                                                                                             | Notes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| --------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| system version                    | Authored compatibility identity declared as `system.version` and copied unchanged into `systemSpec.version` (../packages/core/src/system/makeSystem.ts:54-74, ../packages/core/src/system/makeSystemSpec.ts:21-31).                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | `packages/core/src/system/makeSystem.ts`                                                                  | `SystemWorker.getSystemSpec()` returns this authored value; deployment identity does not overwrite it (../packages/system-worker/src/SystemWorker.ts:880-917).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| instance id                       | Stable identifier for one system Worker environment. Public local development fixes it to `local`; project-owned Wrangler production fixes it to `production` (../packages/dispatch-worker/src/Worker.ts:106-148).                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | `packages/dispatch-worker/src/DevZerospinApis/DevZerospinApis.ts`                                         | It identifies the environment within one system, not a code revision or data lineage. Local routes only to `DevZerospinApis`; production routes only to `SelfHostedZerospinApis`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `ZEROSPIN_SELF_HOSTED`            | Exact runtime marker generated by project-owned Wrangler deployment so lifecycle calls can distinguish a newly uploaded self-hosted Worker from hosted predecessor code (../packages/dispatch-worker/src/SelfHostedZerospinApis/SelfHostedZerospinApis.ts:255-268).                                                                                                                                                              | `packages/dispatch-worker/src/SelfHostedZerospinApis/SelfHostedZerospinApis.ts`                            | Repo generation drains use it to inspect old pending work without executing that work with new code.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| system worker name                | Stable dispatch-script and instance key formed exactly as `{systemId}:{instanceId}` (../packages/dispatch-worker/src/makeSystemWorkerName.ts:1-15).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | `packages/dispatch-worker/src/makeSystemWorkerName.ts`                                                    | Many deploys and generations can belong to one system worker name.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| deploy id                         | Identity allocated for one local or production Worker-version candidate (../packages/dispatch-worker/src/DevZerospinApis/DevZerospinApis.ts:1050-1127, ../packages/dispatch-worker/src/SelfHostedZerospinApis/SelfHostedZerospinApis.ts:1082-1220).                                                                                                                                                                                    | `packages/dispatch-worker/src/DevZerospinApis/DevZerospinApis.ts`                                         | A deploy can fail without becoming active; the same failed Worker version remains mapped to that failed deploy.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| deploy index                      | Monotonic integer ordering of local deploys within one `systemWorkerName`; the pair is unique (../packages/dispatch-worker/src/DevZerospinApis/DevZerospinApis.ts:1100-1127).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | `packages/dispatch-worker/src/DevZerospinApis/DevZerospinApis.ts`                                         | `*Index` is used because this value is an integer sequence; identity remains `deployId`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| previous deploy id                | `prevDeployId` captured from the local instance's `activeDeployId` when a candidate is allocated (../packages/dispatch-worker/src/DevZerospinApis/DevZerospinApis.ts:1110-1127).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | `packages/dispatch-worker/src/DevZerospinApis/DevZerospinApis.ts`                                         | It is the compare-and-swap predecessor for activation, not merely the latest successful row by timestamp (../packages/dispatch-worker/src/DevZerospinApis/DevZerospinApis.ts:1658-1720).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| active deploy id                  | The succeeded, complete local deploy authorized to serve one stable instance. `activatingDeployId` is the exclusive reservation immediately before promotion (../packages/dispatch-worker/src/DevZerospinApis/DevZerospinApis.ts:1490-1628, ../packages/dispatch-worker/src/DevZerospinApis/DevZerospinApis.ts:1658-1750).                                                                                                          | `packages/dispatch-worker/src/DevZerospinApis/DevZerospinApis.ts`                                         | `DevZerospinApis` constructs the ordinary API capability only after promotion (../packages/dispatch-worker/src/DevZerospinApis/DevZerospinApis.ts:1785-1922).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Worker version id                 | Cloudflare Version Metadata `id` for the concrete uploaded code revision, returned beside `deployId` and `generationId` by `SystemWorker.getGenerationId` (../packages/system-worker/src/getGenerationId/getGenerationId.ts:11-28).                                                                                                                                                                                                 | `packages/system-worker/src/getGenerationId/getGenerationId.ts`                                           | It proves code identity. It does not identify persisted data or determine SemVer compatibility.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| generation id                     | Identity of one durable data lineage and the namespace used by every graph repo and SystemLogRepo. SystemRepo is named `sysrepo_{generationId}` (../packages/system-worker/src/SystemRepo/SystemRepo.ts:252-275).                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | `packages/system-worker/src/SystemRepo/SystemRepo.ts`                                                     | Compatible deploys may reuse a generation. An incompatible migrated deploy or explicit clean deploy creates a new generation without deleting the prior generation.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| generation readiness              | `generationState.readiness`: whether generation preparation is `initializing`, `ready`, or `failed` (../packages/system-worker/src/SystemRepo/SystemRepo.ts:59-105).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | `packages/system-worker/src/SystemRepo/SystemRepo.ts`                                                     | Readiness describes durable preparation, not whether ordinary calls are admitted and not the local CLI's `/__zerospin/ready` HTTP gate.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| generation admission              | `generationState.admission`: `closed`, `open`, `draining`, or `drained`, evaluated separately from readiness and against the generation-local active deploy (../packages/system-worker/src/SystemRepo/SystemRepo.ts:85-105, ../packages/system-worker/src/SystemRepo/assertGenerationAdmission/assertGenerationAdmission.ts:84-137).                                                                                                | `packages/system-worker/src/SystemRepo/assertGenerationAdmission/assertGenerationAdmission.ts`            | Reads are allowed in `open` and `draining`; writes only in `open`. `ready + drained` is valid persisted state.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| generation write reservation      | Durable SystemRepo receipt created atomically with write admission and released idempotently when that admitted operation settles (../packages/system-worker/src/SystemRepo/reserveGenerationWrite/reserveGenerationWrite.ts:13-59, ../packages/system-worker/src/SystemRepo/releaseGenerationWrite/releaseGenerationWrite.ts:13-55).                                                                                               | `packages/system-worker/src/SystemRepo/reserveGenerationWrite/reserveGenerationWrite.ts`                  | Freeze closes admission before waiting for the finite pre-existing reservation set; a 30-second row is reported as abandoned and retained rather than expired (../packages/system-worker/src/SystemRepo/drainGeneration/drainGeneration.ts:384-585).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| frozen drain bounds               | Immutable `drainBounds` rows plus non-null `drainFrozenAt` captured after every owner ledger and account/service projection archive reaches an exact terminal watermark (../packages/system-worker/src/SystemRepo/drainGeneration/drainGeneration.ts:836-1691).                                                                                                                                                                     | `packages/system-worker/src/SystemRepo/drainGeneration/drainGeneration.ts`                                | A migration source is `ready + draining + frozen`; `drained` is written only after successor opening and routing promotion (../packages/system-worker/src/SystemRepo/prepareGeneration/prepareGeneration.ts:478-511, ../packages/system-worker/src/SystemRepo/drainGeneration/drainGeneration.ts:176-381).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| self-hosted generation drain      | The normal freeze/complete lineage protocol with repo drain work restricted to read-only terminal-state inspection because the upload contains only new code (../packages/system-worker/src/ServiceBlockRepo/drainGeneration/drainGeneration.ts:11-86).                                                                                                                                                                           | `packages/system-worker/src/ServiceBlockRepo/drainGeneration/drainGeneration.ts`                          | Pending account or service-frontend subscribers fail closed. An already-bootstrapped retired actor/frontend FrontendRepo may use retained account models only for this inspection (../packages/system-worker/src/ServiceBlockRepo/drainGeneration/drainGeneration.ts:88-220, ../packages/system-worker/src/FrontendRepo/FrontendRepo.ts:223-274).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| frontend WebSocket ticket         | A 30-second, one-use, unpadded base64url credential minted for the authoritative account archive. Resolution may follow only a complete recorded drained-successor chain with matching inverse predecessors (../packages/system-worker/src/createFrontendWebSocketTicket/createFrontendWebSocketTicket.ts:38-240).                                                                                                                  | `packages/system-worker/src/createFrontendWebSocketTicket/createFrontendWebSocketTicket.ts`               | The final ready/open projection and archive must prove coverage; its SystemRepo stores only the hash, deploy, server-derived archive name, and expiry before one-use consumption (../packages/system-worker/src/createFrontendWebSocketTicket/createFrontendWebSocketTicket.ts:243-417, ../packages/system-worker/src/SystemWorker.ts:2584-2678).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| service frontend WebSocket ticket | Distinct one-use credential for the authoritative read-only service projection archive. It follows the same complete, inverse-verified successor rule while preserving service/actor/frontend identity (../packages/system-worker/src/createServiceFrontendWebSocketTicket/createServiceFrontendWebSocketTicket.ts:82-265).                                                                                                         | `packages/system-worker/src/createServiceFrontendWebSocketTicket/createServiceFrontendWebSocketTicket.ts` | It has a separate target SystemRepo ticket table, coverage check, consume path, and `/ws-service-frontend-blocks` route; it is never interchangeable with an account ticket (../packages/system-worker/src/createServiceFrontendWebSocketTicket/createServiceFrontendWebSocketTicket.ts:267-451, ../packages/system-worker/src/SystemWorker.ts:2681-2802).                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| previous generation id            | `prevGenerationId` lineage pointer on a local generation; `null` denotes an initial or explicitly clean detached root (../packages/dispatch-worker/src/DevZerospinApis/DevZerospinApis.ts:982-996).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | `packages/dispatch-worker/src/DevZerospinApis/DevZerospinApis.ts`                                         | Migration replays immutable ledgers from this predecessor. Clean intentionally sets it to `null`; it never erases the previous data.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| clean deploy                      | Explicit request for a detached root generation with no replay source. The new generation receives current seeds once, while older generations remain intact (../packages/dispatch-worker/src/DevZerospinApis/DevZerospinApis.ts:878-996, ../packages/dispatch-worker/src/DevZerospinApis/DevZerospinApis.ts:1129-1151, ../packages/dispatch-worker/src/DevZerospinApis/DevZerospinApis.ts:1456-1465).                              | `packages/dispatch-worker/src/DevZerospinApis/DevZerospinApis.ts`                                         | “Clean” means new lineage and a fresh database namespace, never deletion. A clean request id is consumed once across Wrangler constructor restarts.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `SystemLogRepo`                   | Generation-scoped runtime log and telemetry store. Every row carries `systemId`, `generationId`, and the deploy that emitted it (../packages/system-worker/src/SystemLogRepo/SystemLogRepo.ts:47-98).                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | `packages/system-worker/src/SystemLogRepo/SystemLogRepo.ts`                                               | Its monotonic indexes and retention are local to one generation (../packages/system-worker/src/SystemLogRepo/appendLogRow/appendLogRow.ts:78-123).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| local deploy log                  | Instance-scoped append-only operator timeline stored by `DevZerospinApis`; each event records deploy, generation, phase, level, payload, and an integer `eventIndex` (../packages/dispatch-worker/src/DevZerospinApis/DevZerospinApis.ts:142-184).                                                                                                                                                                                  | `packages/dispatch-worker/src/DevZerospinApis/DevZerospinApis.ts`                                         | It is observability only. The local instance/deploy/generation rows remain lifecycle state.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
